name: Mockingbird
description: Flying. You may have this creature enter the battlefield as a copy of any creature on the battlefield with mana value less than or equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it, except it's a Bird in addition to its other types and it has flying.
couldNotDerive: The entire ETB-replacement copy effect and its own X-cost tie-in -- correctly absent rather than shown wrong.
notes: K:ETBReplacement:Copy:DBCopy:Optional -- same already-documented gap class as Eddymurk Crab's own K:ETBReplacement (a real, moderately complex 'enters as a copy of X, optionally' mechanic). Added to that gap class's card list. Flying reconstructs correctly.
